name: App Manager
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Launch · Group · Bind · Inspect: all your apps and plugins in one theme-aware popup. Type to launch; pull the popup wide and the list becomes cards with a group bar to filter and drag apps between groups; sort apps into your own groups or by origin; give any app or app action a global shortcut on a key map that shows who owns every key; and open App info with path, package, size, install date and website. Resize, move and double-click to maximize. Widgets, plugins and tray apps have their own page.
